title: A single-zone install publishes an upper and a lower floor in its space plan
claim: On every single-zone plant (published two_zone_enabled=False) the published space plan carries non-null upper and lower floor temperatures on all 96 forecast rows, so the plan sensor and the card present two floors the configuration does not have; at a clean archive of 92d38ecb this fails 140 of 193 driven d12-cells level cells.
mechanism: OptimizationResult always fills upper_temp_trajectory and lower_temp_trajectory (single zone: both equal the room trajectory), and HeatPumpOptimizerCoordinator._build_plan_views decides two_zone from `bool(result.upper_temp_trajectory and result.lower_temp_trajectory)` rather than from the model's params.two_zone_enabled, so the zone columns are published whenever the lists are non-empty, which is always.

evidence.unit: single-zone plants publishing zone rows (of 8); zone_rows=768
evidence.baseline_sha: 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692 (clean git archive; the export handed to the seat gives zone_plants=2 of 2 single-zone plants, its other 6 plants are two-zone there, see D12-s1-02)
evidence.machine: box B4, 4 vCPU shared container, Python 3.14, numpy/scipy per tests/requirements-ci.txt
evidence.contention_note: counts; box shared with other finder seats (load1 4-5)

perturbation.change: --gate: _build_plan_views decides two_zone from the model's _thermal_params.two_zone_enabled (in memory, mock.patch.object on the method)

metric_definition: zone_plants = single-zone plants (published two_zone_enabled False) whose published space_plan forecast carries a non-null upper or lower on any row
phenomenon_property: The published plan names a floor (upper/lower zone column) only where the model the plan was solved with has two zones; a single-zone install publishes neither.
seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub $HOME/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D12/s1/cells.py --quiet (every d12-cells level; the check 'plan carries a lower-zone trajectory the cell does not have' lists each cell where a published plan carries a zone column the model lacks)

null_control.command: same command; the CONTROL two-zone plant line
null_control.note: the two-zone plant keeps its rows with upper != lower under --gate, so the gate removes only the invented columns

reproduction_steps: git archive 92d38ecb into a clean root; copy dev/audit/rounds/round11/D12/s1/{cells.py,plan_zone.py} into it
run with --gate: zone_plants=0, control rows unchanged
cells.py --quiet at the clean root: the cell sweep prints the same check on the single-zone cells (see REPORT.md)

cells.py --quiet at a clean archive of 92d38ecb: fail_cells=140 of 193, all of the pattern 'plan carries a lower-zone trajectory the cell does not have' (out2/clean_sha_arm_none.txt); the export reads the same 140 plus the D12-s1-02 pattern
proposed_fix_scope: coordinator.py _build_plan_views: gate the upper/lower columns on the solved model's two_zone_enabled (or have the optimizer leave the zone trajectories empty for a single-zone model); card follows the payload
